formatted.title: Change the New request page title to 26C1
formatted.summary: The page title on the New request page (equiprite-future/order/new-request) should be changed to "26C1". The current title and the reason for the change were not given.
questions: What is the current page title?
Should "26C1" replace the whole title, or be added to the existing title?
Which title is meant: the heading shown on the page, the browser tab title, or both?
Does this apply only to the New request page, or to other pages as well?
What is the reason for the change, and is there a deadline?
